messages:
Marta: quick FYI — pushed the mini-sparkline variant to the mock: shows p95 overlay + tiny histogram under the heatmap. wondering about the control label for sampling: 'Sampling' vs 'Sample rate' vs 'Downsample'. which feels clearest? Alex: 'Sample rate' reads more quantitative to me. 'Sampling' is a bit vague for new users. Jun: +1 to 'Sample rate'. also we should clarify units (eg. 1/10s or 10%). inline help maybe: 'Sample rate — percent of traces used for heatmap'. Sam: UX thought: the scrubber preview currently snaps to bucket centers; can we make it snap to actual event times when zoomed in? feels more precise for investigations. Marta: yeah good call. design will try an elastic threshold: snap-to-bucket until the zoom < 5m then switch to event snap. Aria (a11y): a11y nit — the sampling menu needs an accessible label and keyboard nav. Current select isn't announced properly by VoiceOver. Should be role="combobox" and have aria-describedby pointing to helper text. Jun: here's a quick snippet we can prototype: ```
``` Alex: nice. also copy tweak: change 'Auto' to 'Adaptive (latency-aware)'? long but clearer. alternative: tooltip explaining what Auto does. Marta: not keen on long label inside compact toolbar. prefer short label + info icon. maybe 'Adaptive' + tooltip text 'Automatically adjusts sample rate based on request volume and p95 delta'. Sam: interaction question — when user changes sample rate, should heatmap refresh immediately or show 'apply' button? immediate feels responsive but heavier for large result sets. Jun: propose debounce + small spinner: apply changes live but debounce 300ms and show a subtle loading dot in the control. preserves immediacy without hammering backend. Aria (a11y): ensure spinner has role="status" and announces "Updating heatmap". don't rely on color alone for state. Marta: acceptance criteria for handoff: 1) label updated to 'Sample rate' with info tooltip copy; 2) keyboard/vo announcements implemented; 3) snapping behavior documented; 4) debounce spinner added. anyone object? Alex: LGTM. I'll add the tooltip copy suggestion in the figma comments. Sam: I'll scope the backend debounce support and add perf test. design-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled in #design in 20 minutes. Attachments: figma link -> https://figma.com/file/abc123/sparkline-sampling Marta: thanks — let's iterate quickly in the review. :thumbsup:
